# stripe_setup_intent resource: `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie`

The `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie` attribute of the [`stripe_setup_intent`](../resources/setup_intent) resource, on a page of its own to keep that page within the Registry's size limit.

<a id="last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie"></a>
### `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie`

The `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie` attribute supports:

* `capture_method` - Controls when the funds will be captured from the customer's account. Possible values: `manual`, `automatic_delayed`, `manual_preferred`.
* `company_details` - See [`last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details`](#last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details) below.
* `installments` - See [`last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments`](#last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments) below.
* `mandate_options` - See [`last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.mandate_options`](#last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.mandate_options) below.
* `reference` - An identifier or reference that this payment corresponds to.
* `request_incremental_authorization_support` - Request ability to [increment](https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/incremental-authorizations) this PaymentIntent if the combination of MCC and card brand is eligible. Check [incremental_authorization_supported](https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges/object#charge_object-payment_method_details-card_present-incremental_authorization_supported) in the [Confirm](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/confirm) response to verify support.
* `require_cvc_recollection` - When enabled, using a card that is attached to a customer will require the CVC to be provided again (i.e. using the cvc_token parameter).
* `routing` - See [`last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.routing`](#last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.routing) below.
* `setup_future_usage` - Indicates that you intend to make future payments with this PaymentIntent's payment method. If you provide a Customer with the PaymentIntent, you can use this parameter to [attach the payment method](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/save-during-payment) to the Customer after the PaymentIntent is confirmed and the customer completes any required actions. If you don't provide a Customer, you can still [attach](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods/attach) the payment method to a Customer after the transaction completes. If the payment method is `card_present` and isn't a digital wallet, Stripe creates and attaches a [generated_card](https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges/object#charge_object-payment_method_details-card_present-generated_card) payment method representing the card to the Customer instead. When processing card payments, Stripe uses `setup_future_usage` to help you comply with regional legislation and network rules, such as [SCA](https://docs.stripe.com/strong-customer-authentication). Possible values: `none`, `off_session`, `on_session`.
* `verification_method` - Bank account verification method. The default value is `automatic`. Possible values: `automatic`, `instant`, `microdeposits`.

<a id="last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details"></a>
### `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details`

The `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details` attribute supports:

* `registered_address` - See [`last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details.registered_address`](#last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details.registered_address) below.
* `registered_name` - Company or entity name.
* `registration_number` - The official registration number for the given registration type.
* `registration_type` - Type of registration the company or entity holds in their registered country. Possible values: `ch_ein`, `de_hrb`, `dk_cvr`, `es_cif`, `fi_tunnus`, `fr_siren`, `fr_siret`, `it_rea`, `nl_kvk`, `no_org_number`, `no_pno`, `se_org_number`, `se_pno`, `uk_crn`.
* `vat` - VAT id number

<a id="last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details.registered_address"></a>
### `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details.registered_address`

The `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.company_details.registered_address` attribute supports:

* `city` - City, district, suburb, town, or village.
* `country` - Two-letter country code.
* `line1` - Address line 1 (e.g., street, PO Box, or company name).
* `line2` - Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building).
* `postal_code` - ZIP or postal code.
* `state` - State, county, province, or region.

<a id="last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments"></a>
### `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments`

The `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments` attribute supports:

* `enabled` -
* `plan` - See [`last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments.plan`](#last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments.plan) below.

<a id="last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments.plan"></a>
### `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments.plan`

The `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.installments.plan` attribute supports:

* `count` - For `fixed_count` installment plans, this is the number of installment payments your customer will make to their credit card.
* `interval` - For `fixed_count` installment plans, this is the interval between installment payments your customer will make to their credit card. One of `month`. Possible values: `month`.
* `type` - Type of installment plan, one of `fixed_count`, `bonus`, or `revolving`. Possible values: `bonus`, `fixed_count`, `revolving`.

<a id="last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.mandate_options"></a>
### `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.mandate_options`

The `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.mandate_options` attribute supports:

* `amount` - Amount that will be collected. It is required when `amount_type` is `fixed`.
* `amount_type` - The type of amount that will be collected. The amount charged must be exact or up to the value of `amount` param for `fixed` or `maximum` type respectively. Defaults to `maximum`. Possible values: `fixed`, `maximum`.
* `end_date` - Date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, after which payments will not be collected. Defaults to no end date.
* `payment_schedule` - The periodicity at which payments will be collected. Defaults to `adhoc`. Possible values: `adhoc`, `annual`, `daily`, `fortnightly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semi_annual`, `weekly`.
* `payments_per_period` - The number of payments that will be made during a payment period. Defaults to 1 except for when `payment_schedule` is `adhoc`. In that case, it defaults to no limit.
* `purpose` - The purpose for which payments are made. Has a default value based on your merchant category code. Possible values: `dependant_support`, `government`, `loan`, `mortgage`, `other`, `pension`, `personal`, `retail`, `salary`, `tax`, `utility`.

<a id="last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.routing"></a>
### `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.routing`

The `last_setup_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.billie.routing` attribute supports:

* `requested_priority` - Requested routing priority Possible values: `domestic`, `international`.
